main.bio: Hello! I am Nathan. I am a self-taught software developer passionate in building delightful web applications that transform business. I founded my own digital agency in 2020, named Adcuro Digital, to help local businesses adapt to the digital-first climate. My focus back then was WordPress development and integration with popular CRM. Now, I am working full-time as Power Platform developer and is enjoying developing solutions on this heavy-duty ERP/CRM platform.
